rules.content:
title: Investment TDS Geo-Routing to Legitimate Platform
status: experimental
description: Detect Traffic Distribution System (TDS) geo-routing patterns used in investment scam infrastructure: (1) same domain resolving to different IP addresses based on requester geography, (2) US-based vis
logsource:
    product: dns
    category: dns_analytics
    service: passive_dns
detection:
    selection_geo_variance:
        domain_ip_geo_variance: true
        unique_resolution_ips|gte: 3
        geo_routing_detected: true
    selection_legitimate_redirect:
        redirect_target|contains:
            - "etoro.com"
            - "coinbase.com"
            - "robinhood.com"
            - "fidelity.com"
        source_geo: "US"
    selection_cname_tds:
        cname_chain_length|gte: 2
        cname_target_domain_age_days|lt: 30
        cname_routing_pattern: true
    selection_domain_age:
        domain_registration_age_days|lt: 30
        non_us_redirect_target: true
    condition: (selection_geo_variance and selection_legitimate_redirect) or (selection_cname_tds and selection_domain_age)
level: medium
rules.title: DL-0120: Investment TDS Geo-Routing to Legitimate Platform (Sigma)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Keitaro/Binom TDS Abuse Infrastructure Detection")`
`comment("HTTP redirect chain analysis for TDS abuse patterns")`
index=flame_proxy sourcetype=flame:http_log
(url_query="*click_id=*" OR url_query="*campaign_id=*" OR url_query="*keitaro*" OR url_query="*binom*" OR url_query="*cnv_id=*")
OR (url_path="*/tracker/*" OR url_path="*/click/*" OR url_path="*/go/*" OR url_path="*/click.php*")
| transaction session_id maxspan=30s
| where eventcount>=3
| eval redirect_chain=mvjoin(url, " -> ")
| eval has_keitaro=if(like(url_query, "%keitaro%") OR like(url_path, "%/tracker/%"), 1, 0)
| eval has_binom=if(like(url_query, "%binom%") OR like(url_path, "%/click.php%"), 1, 0)
| where has_keitaro=1 OR has_binom=1
| stats count values(redirect_chain) as chains values(final_destination) as destinations by src_ip session_id
rules.title: DL-0122: Keitaro/Binom TDS Abuse Infrastructure Detection (SPLUNK)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for TDS URL Parameter Fingerprint Tracking")`
`comment("Identifies consistent TDS parameter patterns across rotating domains")`
index=flame_proxy sourcetype=flame:http_log http_status IN (301, 302, 307)
(url_query="*?u=*&o=*" OR url_query="*aff_id=*&click_id=*" OR url_query="*subid=*&source=*&clickid=*" OR url_query="*pid=*&offer_id=*")
| rex field=url_query "(?<param_pattern>[a-z_]+=)[^&]*(&[a-z_]+=)[^&]*"
| eval param_fingerprint=param_pattern
| lookup domain_age_feed dest_domain OUTPUT domain_age_days
| where domain_age_days < 90 OR isnull(domain_age_days)
| stats dc(dest_domain) AS unique_domains
        values(dest_domain) AS domains
        dc(src_ip) AS unique_visitors
        count AS total_hits
        earliest(_time) AS first_seen
        latest(_time) AS last_seen
    by param_fingerprint
| where unique_domains >= 3
| sort -unique_domains
rules.title: DL-0127: TDS URL Parameter Fingerprint Tracking Across Rotating Domains (SPLUNK)
